purpose: Test bounded repeated observation with a runtime stopping condition.
goal: Open https://httpbin.org/uuid in a rendered browser repeatedly, no more than 8 times. After each result, inspect the UUID. Finish when its first hexadecimal character is in 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7, otherwise continue until attempt 8. Save every observed result under canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/UUID_LOOP_ATTEMPTS and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/UUID_LOOP_RESULT.json with status, attempts, matched, selected_uuid, and selected_attempt. Independently verify the saved trace and stopping decision.
